title: 21-Year-Old Man Attempts to Outrun Police Then Spits on Officer
description:
On February 18, 2022, an officer responded to a residence for a domestic call for service in La Crosse, WI. Upon the officer’s arrival, he noticed a male exit the residence and flee on foot. After a short foot pursuit, he was apprehended and refused to comply with any commands by the officers.
